ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon (Aqua Blizzard / Shuckworm) initial-access chain — Office/archive spawning mshta/wscript referencing Telegram/Telegraph/Cloudflare
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Gamaredon delivery chain: a phishing-borne Office doc, HTML smuggling LNK, or RAR/7z archive spawning mshta.exe / wscript.exe / cscript.exe whose command line references HTTP(S), Telegraph (telegra.ph), Telegram (t.me), Cloudflare workers/trycloudflare, or one of the throwaway TLDs (.ru, .online, .space, .fun, .site) Gamaredon rotates for C2 dead-drop resolvers. The pairing of an Office/archive parent + script-interpreter child + remote-content cmdline is the Gamaredon GammaLoad / PteroPSDoor delivery signature documented by ESET, Symantec, and CERT-UA.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","explorer.exe","WinRAR.exe","7zFM.exe","7zG.exe") BY host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id Processes.parent_process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process,"(?i)(https?://|telegra\.ph|t\.me/|workers\.dev|trycloudflare\.com|\.online\b|\.ru\b|\.space\b|\.fun\b|\.site\b|GetObject|XMLHTTP|MSXML2|WScript\.Shell)") | join type=outer dest process_id [| tstats summariesonly=t values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as c2_ip values(All_Traffic.dest) as c2_host values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as c2_port FROM datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic WHERE All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal" BY All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.process_id | rename All_Traffic.src as dest All_Traffic.process_id as process_id] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process c2_host c2_ip c2_port
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SuspectCmdRegex = @"(?i)(https?://|telegra\.ph|t\.me/|workers\.dev|trycloudflare\.com|\.online\b|\.ru\b|\.space\b|\.fun\b|\.site\b|GetObject\(|XMLHTTP|MSXML2|WScript\.Shell)";
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell)\.exe$"
| where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|explorer|winrar|7zfm|7zg)\.exe$"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine matches regex SuspectCmdRegex
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ProcessId=NewProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

status: experimental
description: Office app, Outlook, Explorer, or archive utility spawning mshta/wscript/cscript/powershell whose command line references HTTP(S), Telegram, Telegraph, Cloudflare workers, or throwaway TLDs Gamaredon (Aqua Blizzard / Shuckworm / Primitive Bear) rotates for GammaLoad/PteroPSDoor staging.

    - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2023/03/14/slow-ticking-time-bomb-tracking-gamaredon/

date: 2026/05/25
tags:

logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:

            - '\outlook.exe'
            - '\explorer.exe'
            - '\WinRAR.exe'
            - '\7zFM.exe'
            - '\7zG.exe'
    child:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\mshta.exe'
            - '\wscript.exe'
            - '\cscript.exe'

    cmdline_remote:
        CommandLine|contains:

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\7zFM.exe OR *\\7zG.exe) @Image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE) @CommandLine:(*http\:* OR *https\:* OR *telegra.ph* OR *t.me/* OR *workers.dev* OR *trycloudflare* OR *.online* OR *.ru/* OR *.space* OR *XMLHTTP* OR *WScript.Shell*)

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|explorer|winrar|7zfm|7zg)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(https?://|telegra\\.ph|t\\.me/|workers\\.dev|trycloudflare\\.com|\\.online\\b|\\.ru\\b|\\.space\\b|\\.fun\\b|\\.site\\b|XMLHTTP|WScript\\.Shell|GetObject\\()", field=CommandLine)

ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon (Shuckworm) PteroLNK USB worm — script interpreter spawned by Explorer from removable-drive LNK
ucs.description: Hunts Gamaredon's PteroLNK / USB-borne propagation: a LNK file dropped to the root of a removable drive that, when clicked, causes explorer.exe to launch wscript/cscript/mshta with a command line referencing a removable drive letter (D:-Z:) and a script extension. Symantec and Cisco Talos have repeatedly attributed this exact USB-LNK + VBS chain to Gamaredon (PteroLNK module of GammaLoad) — it is one of the few APT-grade USB worms still actively deployed against Ukrainian targets in 2024-2026.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE Processes.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" BY host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process,"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\\\.*\.(vbs|vbe|js|jse|hta|cmd|bat|wsf|lnk|ps1)\b") | join type=outer dest [| tstats summariesonly=t values(Filesystem.file_path) as lnk_path values(Filesystem.file_hash) as lnk_hash FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem WHERE Filesystem.file_name="*.lnk" AND Filesystem.file_path IN ("D:\\*","E:\\*","F:\\*","G:\\*","H:\\*","I:\\*","J:\\*") AND Filesystem.action="created" BY Filesystem.dest | rename Filesystem.dest as dest] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process lnk_path lnk_hash
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith @"\explorer.exe"
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(wscript|cscript|mshta|cmd|powershell)\.exe$"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\.*\.(vbs|vbe|js|jse|hta|cmd|bat|wsf|lnk|ps1)\b"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
